shortDescription: Commander, we are trying to prevent a major landing on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and we need you to go in and smash the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} beach head. Wreck the force protecting the LZ and wreck any convoy or lance trying to leave the area. This is a test for this mission shape. This is a large and complex mission.
longDescription: They are already on the ground. Get them off it.

contractObjectiveList.title: Stop the Enemy Lances and Convoys from Escaping

dialogueContent.words: Heavy Lance is down.
That Assault Lance is out of the fight.

Commander, there is a pair of enemy battle lances defending the landing ground and they are big. We've got allies coming in from the north to assist as well. Expect landing by other enemy forces to begin shortly.
That's it, Commander, the landings have been stopped. Great job.
We've failed to prevent the landings, Commander.
The landings are DOA, Commander, we can head for our dust off now.
Enemy Lance 1 is on the ground and moving.
Lance 1 is at their hold point. Take them out fast before they move on.
Lance 1 is away. We've failed.
Convoy 2 is down and moving. Get on them!
Convoy 2 has reached their hold point.
Convoy 2 is away. We've dropped the ball on this one.
Lance 3 is on the ground.
Lance 3 is at their hold point.
Lance 3 is away. The contract has failed.
Convoy 4 is moving.
Convoy 4 is almost gone.
Convoy is away. We have failed, despite all our efforts.
Lance 1 has taken a loss.
Convoy 2 has taken a big hit.
Lance 3 has a 'Mech down.
Convoy 4 is damaged.
Convoy 1 is at the lift point. Take them down as fast as you can.
Convoy 2 is at the lift point. Take them down as fast as you can.
Lance 3 is at the lift point. Take them down as fast as you can.
Convoy 4 is at the lift point. Take them down as fast as you can.
